title: S0 report (with the Sonnet runs and the input diagnosis)
question: Can D1's claim model and schema and guideline v0 express what the core units state, and how determinate is annotation and adjudication?
method: Report rendered from the evidence catalog (ADR-0010): figures are queries over the S0 records' outputs; prose by the root. catalog.sql extended on 2026-10-28 to read the S0-R2 comparisons too; the report re-rendered identically (input hash refreshed).
conclusion: The claim model fits with a few constructs missing; annotators agree on content (core 0.93) far more than on qualifiers (full 0.63); Sonnet matches Opus on content and adjudicates close to the root (0.97/0.82), and the qualifier gap of the smaller models sits at conventions the inputs do not state, so the inputs, not the models, are the next change; the packet loses nothing at a fixed model; two key rules and two scope rules to change.
